name: 吳昭正
objective: 布林代數與邏輯閘，組合邏輯，算術演算邏輯，同步循序邏輯，演繹狀態機，非同步循序邏輯。
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1(9/7、9). Introduction 
Week 2(9/14、16). Number systems、Holiday
Week 3(9/21、23). Boolean Algebra (I) 
Week 4(9/28、9/30). Holiday ; Boolean Algebra (II) 
Week 5(10/5、7). Applications of Boolean algebra minterm and maxterm expansions
Week 6(10/12、14). Karnaugh Maps (I)
Week 7(10/19、21). Karnaugh Maps (II)
Week 8(10/26、28). Holiday ; Quine-McClusky Method 
Week 9(11/2). Midterm Exam
Week 10(11/9、11). Holiday ; Leave for a conference
Week 11(11/16、18). Multi-Level Gate Circuits NAND and NOR Gates
Week 12(11/23、25). Combinational Circuit Design and Simulation Using Gates
Week 13(11/30、12/2). Multiplexers, Decoders, and Programmable Logic Devices
Week 14(12/7、9). Latches and Flip-Flops
Week 15(12/14、16). Registers and Counters
Week 16(12/21、23). State Machines (I)
Week 17(12/28、12/30). State Machines (II)
Week 18(1/4). Final Exam
